Metalheads, can you hear the battle cry echoing?🗣️ RATATATA!!🤘

ONLY 2 DAYS LEFT until tickets to the @BABYMETAL_JAPAN WORLD TOUR 2025-2026 IN ASIA LIVE IN MANILA will be made available. The beautiful reckoning is at-hand! 🤝 On October 8, 2025, at the Smart Araneta Coliseum, Philippine rock fans will witness a clash of sonic fury and euphoria - as the screams fuel the fire in the moshpit! ❤️‍🔥

Go all-in! Secure the VIP Package (Standing) tickets for priority entry, VIP badge, and an official poster for a full-force experience. 🔥Ticketing starts on June 14, 2025, at 12PM PHT via @TicketNetPH outlets and https://t.co/jn6ny7yHaC. 

#BABYMETALinMANILA

data.raw_text:
LOOK: Progressive groups march along T.M. Kalaw Avenue near the U.S. Embassy on Thursday , June 12, to commemorate the 127th Independence Day.

The ‘Independence Day’ protest denounces U.S. military expansion in the Philippines and accuses Marcos Jr. administration of compromising national sovereignty in favor of the U.S. interests.(📷John Louie Abrina/MB)
